correctness.rationale: Every cycle geodesic is an arc of at most m=floor(n/2) edges. Three selected edges are legal iff each cyclic gap is <=ceil(n/2); four are legal iff every adjacent pair of four gaps sums <=ceil(n/2). A hypothetical legal five-set forces 3n<=5ceil(n/2), contradiction for n>=6. Count valid gap compositions with at most one oversized gap, divide by three initial-edge markings; quartets satisfy alternating gaps (even n) or two complementary adjacent-pair sums (odd). A legal triple extends to a quartet exactly when some gap >=m; otherwise it is maximal. Each 0,1,2-set extends. These identities prove explicit A_n,B_n,M_n and n=7 purity exception. Independent geodesic-mask enumeration checked all 16,376 subsets n=3..13; finite data corroborate universal gap proof.

value.rationale: The full polynomial and inclusion-maximal size spectrum answer a motivated enumerative problem on the most basic non-tree graph, revealing exactly where legal sets are pure versus non-pure. Maximality, rather than just maximum size, is an important distinction for graph-position invariants and algorithmic counting.

final_claim: All legal edge-general-position subsets of C_n are counted by the exact cardinality polynomial P_n for every n>=3, and all inclusion-maximal subsets by M_n with explicit cubic and quartic coefficients. For n>=6 no legal set has size five, and maximal cardinalities are 3 or 4 except n=7 with only size 4; the legal independence system is pure iff n=3,4,5,7.
